title: IntentContractV1
description: Frozen intent oracle for one PR review lineage (#1518). Reviewers evaluate this contract; any change to goal, non-goals, invariants, acceptance criteria, declared paths, or original base/head MUST change intentHash. See docs/specs/bounded-pr-review-lifecycle/spec.md.

lineageId.description: Stable PR-lineage identifier shared by the budget, finding ledger, and receipts of this lineage.

nonGoals.description: Explicit non-goals. An empty array is allowed only when recorded deliberately.

id.description: Stable criterion id (e.g. AC-1). Findings reference these ids.

allowed.description: Declared/allowed path globs for this lineage.

forbidden.description: Forbidden paths remain the security boundary (#1234/#1235).

baseSha.description: Original PR base SHA at lineage freeze.

headSha.description: Original author head SHA at lineage freeze.

intentHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON serialization (sorted keys, UTF-8, no insignificant whitespace) of every field except createdAt and intentHash.
